messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: SVC-AUTOSCALE-QUEUE -> severity P1. Queue depth > 95% for inference-cell-us-west-2. Affected routes: /generate (hosted). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/SVC-AUTOSCALE-QUEUE

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert triggered for SVC-AUTOSCALE-QUEUE. Escalation policy: 'Inference Oncall'. Initial page sent to maria.h.

maria.h: ack — looking into it now.

maria.h: quick triage: autoscaler controller up but provisioning lagging. Kube shows spot pool attach delays and provider API 429s. Queue depth still rising, small subset of requests returning 504s. Collecting pod events and scale logs.

davep: copy. can we trigger hotpool manual spinup? runbook snippet: `rictl pools scale --name hotpath --count 8`

maria.h: executing manual scale now...

deploy-bot: Command executed: `rictl pools scale --name hotpath --count 8` — provisioning 8 nodes (request id: abc123).

maria.h: provision started, ETA ~2-3m. temporarily set autoscaler cooldown to 30s per runbook to help reactive scaling.

ryan.keller: note — if provisioning stalls we should shift traffic to smaller model variants to lower per-request resource. I can push a routing tweak to prioritize customer tenants A,B,C.

maria.h: applying routing adjustment: `proxyctl route set --route /generate --weights smallmodel=0.6,base=0.4` — will watch impact on latency.

support: FYI customer A (INC-3421) reporting elevated 504s since 11:23. Not a global outage but high impact for that tenant. CS notified.

maria.h: thanks. opened incident note and linked INC-3421. reducing per-host concurrency to slow queue growth while nodes come up.

davep: autoscaler logs show provider rate limiting (429) on node create calls. I've opened AWS ticket AWS-789 to request quota bump / expedite.

maria.h: plan B ready if provisioning fails: redirect non-critical traffic to Dedicated fallback and enable stricter throttling. I'll escalate to sales/CS for customer communication.

oncall-next: @maria.h heads-up — I'm taking next rotation in ~30m, can take over continuity if you need.

maria.h: ack. will post handoff update in 20m with current metrics. current queue depth trending: peaked ~98% -> now ~78% after manual scale kicked off.

incident-bot: Alert update: queue depth stabilized at 67% after manual scale, 504 rate decreased to 0.8%. Auto-resolve scheduled in 15m if metrics hold.

maria.h: closing page for now; monitoring 30m. I notified customer-facing teams and updated runbook notes. leaving handoff to @oncall-next if it regresses. :white_check_mark:
